青蛙弗洛格坐在小河边，他心里涌动着一种说不清的感觉，他自己也不知道这到底是快乐还是悲伤。
整整一个星期了，他都是这样神情恍惚地走来走去。到底出了什么事呢？
page_text_en:
Frog sits by the little river, with a strange, indescribable feeling in his heart. He himself doesn't know if it's happiness or sadness.
For a whole week, he has been walking around in a daze. What on earth is going on?
summary_zh: 青蛙弗洛格坐在河边，内心充满一种无法言说的情绪，他不知道是快乐还是悲伤，已经这样恍惚了一整个星期。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，弗洛格遇见了小猪。“嗨，弗洛格！”小猪说，“你看起来不太好。出了什么事？”“我也不知道。”弗洛格说，“我一会儿想哭一会儿又想笑。我身体里还有个东西怦怦地跳，就在这里！”
“你可能是着凉了，”小猪说，“你最好回家卧床休息。”弗洛格心事重重地继续往前走。
page_text_en:
At this moment, Frog met Pig. "Hi, Frog!" Pig said, "You don't look very well. What's wrong?" "I don't know," Frog said, "Sometimes I want to cry, sometimes I want to laugh. There's something thumping inside me, right here!"
"You might have caught a cold," Pig said, "You'd better go home and rest in bed." Frog continued walking ahead, heavy-hearted.
summary_zh: 弗洛格在草地上遇见小猪，向他倾诉自己内心复杂、难以言说的情绪，小猪以为他生病了，建议他回家休息，弗洛格却继续前行。

page_text_ocr_zh:
弗洛格路过野兔的家。“野兔，”他说，“我感觉有点不舒服。”“进来坐吧。”野兔和蔼地说。“现在说说看，你到底怎么了？”野兔问。“我一会儿冷一会儿热的。”弗洛格说，“而且有一个东西一直在我身体里怦怦地跳，就在这里。”他把手放在胸口上说。
野兔像一个真正的医生似的认真思考着。“我知道了，”他说，“那是你的心脏。我的心脏也怦怦地跳。”“但是它有时跳得比较快。”弗洛格说，“很有节奏哩：一、二、一、二、一、二！”野兔从书架上抽出一本书看。“哈！”野兔说，“注意听着：心跳加速、忽冷忽热……这表示你恋爱了！”“恋爱？”弗洛格惊讶地说，“噢，我恋爱了！
page_text_en:
Frog passed by Rabbit's house. "Rabbit," he said, "I feel a bit unwell." "Come in and sit down," Rabbit said kindly. "Now tell me, what's wrong with you?" Rabbit asked. "I feel cold sometimes and hot sometimes," Frog said, "and something has been thumping inside my body, right here." He placed his hand on his chest.
Rabbit thought carefully, like a real doctor. "I know," he said, "that's your heart. My heart thumps too." "But sometimes it beats faster," Frog said, "in a rhythm: one, two, one, two, one, two!" Rabbit took a book from the shelf. "Ha!" Rabbit said, "Listen: a racing heart,忽冷忽热... that means you're in love!" "In love?" Frog said in surprise, "Oh, I'm in love!"
summary_zh: 弗洛格向野兔倾诉自己身体不适、忽冷忽热且心跳加速的奇怪感觉，野兔查阅书籍后判断他这是恋爱了，弗洛格因此惊喜地意识到自己恋爱了。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他兴奋地向上一跳。跳出了野兔家，跳到空中去了。
page_text_en: He jumped up excitedly. He jumped out of Rabbit's house and into the air.
summary_zh: 弗洛格兴奋地跳出了野兔家，跳到空中，表现出他得知自己恋爱后的喜悦之情。

page_text_ocr_zh:
弗洛格突然从天而降，把小猪吓了一跳，“你看起来好多了！”小猪说。“没错！我觉得很好。”弗洛格回答，“我恋爱了！”“这真是个好消息。你爱上了谁呢？”小猪问。这倒是弗洛格没有想到的问题。
“我知道了！”他想了想回答说，“我爱上了美丽、善良又可爱的白色小鸭。”“不可能！”小猪说，“青蛙不能跟鸭子谈恋爱！因为你是绿色的而她是白色的。”弗洛格没有理会小猪的话，他才不会为这件事而烦恼呢。
page_text_en:
Frog suddenly dropped from the sky, startling Pig. "You look much better!" Pig said. "That's right! I feel great," Frog replied. "I'm in love!" "That's wonderful news. Who do you love?" Pig asked. This was a question Frog hadn't considered.
"I know!" he thought and answered, "I've fallen for a beautiful, kind, and lovely white duck." "Impossible!" Pig said. "Frogs can't fall in love with ducks! You're green and she's white." Frog didn't pay attention to Pig's words. He wouldn't worry about this at all.
summary_zh: 弗洛格兴奋地告诉小猪自己恋爱了，并透露他爱上了白色的小鸭，小猪对此表示怀疑并认为青蛙和鸭子因颜色不同无法恋爱，但弗洛格并不在意。

傍晚，当夜幕降临时，弗洛格带着自己画的图画来到小鸭家，将图画塞到门缝底下。因为太兴奋了，他的心跳得很快。
page_text_en:
Frog can't write, but he can draw beautiful pictures. After returning home, he drew a lovely picture using red, blue, and his favorite green.
In the evening, as night fell, Frog took the picture he had drawn to Duck's house and slipped it under the door. He was so excited that his heart was beating fast.

The little duck was very surprised when she found this picture.
"Who sent such a beautiful picture to me?" she called happily, and hung the painting on the wall.

The next day, Frog picked a beautiful bouquet of flowers to give to the little duck. But when he reached the door, he suddenly felt shy and couldn't face her. So he placed the flowers on the stone step in front of the door, then ran away quickly. Day after day passed, and Frog just couldn't gather the courage to go talk to the little duck.
summary_zh: 小鸭收到弗洛格送的画后非常开心，将其挂在墙上；第二天弗洛格想送花给小鸭，却因害羞而将花放在门口后跑开，始终鼓不起勇气当面交谈。

收到这么多漂亮的礼物，小鸭非常高兴。但是礼物是谁送的呢？
可怜的弗洛格！他不想吃饭，也不想睡觉。就这样，好几个星期过去了。
page_text_en:
Receiving so many beautiful gifts, the little duck was very happy. But who sent the gifts?
Poor Frog! He didn't want to eat, nor did he want to sleep. Like this, several weeks passed.
summary_zh: 小鸭收到弗洛格送的花束后非常开心，但不知道是谁送的；而弗洛格因思念小鸭，变得食欲不振、无法安睡，已持续好几个星期。

他要怎样向小鸭表达爱意呢？“我要做一件别人做不到的事。”弗洛格下了决心。“我要打破跳高的世界记录！这样我亲爱的小鸭就会非常惊喜，然后她就会也爱上我。”
弗洛格马上开始训练。他每天不停地跳，越跳越高，都够得到天上的云朵了。以前世界上还没有一只青蛙能跳得像他这么高。
page_text_en:
How could he express his feelings to the little duck? “I’m going to do something no one else can do,” Frog decided. “I’m going to break the world record for high jumping! Then my dear little duck will be very surprised, and then she’ll love me too.”
Frog immediately began training. He jumped every day, higher and higher, until he could almost reach the clouds. No frog in the world had ever jumped as high as he did.
summary_zh: 弗洛格决心通过打破跳高世界纪录来向小鸭表达爱意，并为此每天刻苦训练，跳得越来越高。

“弗洛格怎么了？”小鸭担心地问。“再这样跳下去是很危险的。他会受伤的！”结果被小鸭不幸说中了。
星期五下午两点十三分，弗洛格出事了。当他正要打破跳高世界纪录的时候，身体失去了平衡，摔落到地上。小鸭正好路过，急忙跑过去帮助他。
page_text_en:
"What's wrong with Frog?" the duck asked worriedly. "Jumping like this is very dangerous. He might get hurt!" And the duck was unfortunately right.
At 2:13 PM on Friday, Frog had an accident. Just as he was about to break the world high-jump record, he lost his balance and fell to the ground. The duck happened to be passing by and rushed over to help him.
summary_zh: 弗洛格在跳高训练中失去平衡摔倒，小鸭恰好路过并上前帮助他。

弗洛格摔得几乎不能走路了。小鸭小心地扶着他，将他带到自己的家里。她无微不至地照顾他。“噢！弗洛格，你差点儿就没命了！”她说，“你一定要小心。我真的很喜欢你！”就在此时，弗洛格终于鼓起了勇气。“亲爱的小鸭，我也非常喜欢你。”他结结巴巴地说。他的心跳得比往常更快了，脸也涨成了深绿色。
从此以后，他们互相深爱着对方。一只青蛙和一只鸭子……绿色配白色。爱是不受肤色限制的。
page_text_en:
Frog was hurt so badly he could hardly walk. The little duck carefully helped him and took him to her home. She took care of him with great care. "Oh! Frog, you almost died!" she said. "You must be careful. I really like you!" At that moment, Frog finally gathered his courage. "Dear little duck, I like you very much too," he stammered. His heart beat faster than ever before, and his face turned deep green.
From then on, they loved each other deeply. A frog and a duck... green with white. Love is not limited by skin color.
summary_zh: 弗洛格在跳高训练中摔倒，小鸭扶他回家并悉心照顾，两人终于互相表白，确认了彼此的爱意。画面展现了他们之后在船上共度时光的幸福场景，并点明爱不受肤色限制的主题。

page_text_ocr_zh:
学会给予爱和接受爱

爱是世界上最伟大的情感之一。我们每天都生活在爱的世界里，有爸爸妈妈的爱、爷爷奶奶的爱、老师的爱、好朋友的爱……在接收这些爱的同时，我们更要学会给予爱，学会关爱身边的人。

想一想

1. 弗洛格觉得不舒服，他怎么了？
2. 弗洛格很喜欢小鸭，他偷偷送给了小鸭什么礼物？
3. 为了小鸭，弗洛格决心做一件别人做不到的事情，是什么事情？
4. 弗洛格出了什么意外？小鸭是怎么对待他的？

试一试

试着做一件事情，让爸爸妈妈感受到你对他们的爱。

—— 作者简介 ——

马克斯·维尔修思 1923 年出生于荷兰海牙，2005 年去世，享年 81 岁。他被认为是荷兰最伟大的儿童图画书创作人之一。“青蛙弗洛格的成长故事”系列图画书是他留给世界的“绝唱”式作品，被誉为是“简笔画世界的杰作”。该系列荣获过诸多重要奖项，包括荷兰的“Golden Pencil”大奖、法国的“Prix de Treize”大奖、德国的“Bestlist Award”大奖、并最终在 2004 年荣获“The Hans Christian Andersen Medal”（国际安徒生插图奖）。
page_text_en:
Learning to Give and Receive Love

Love is one of the greatest emotions in the world. We live in a world full of love every day—love from our parents, grandparents, teachers, and good friends... While receiving this love, we must also learn to give love and care for the people around us.

Think About It

1. Froggy felt unwell. What was wrong with him?
2. Froggy really liked Duck. What gift did he secretly give to Duck?
3. For Duck, Froggy decided to do something no one else could do. What was it?
4. What accident happened to Froggy? How did Duck treat him?

Try It

Try doing something to let your parents feel your love for them.

—— Author Introduction ——

Max Velthuijs was born in The Hague, Netherlands in 1923 and passed away in 2005 at the age of 81. He is considered one of the greatest children's picture book creators in the Netherlands. The "Froggy's Growing-Up Stories" series is his "swan song"-style legacy, hailed as a "masterpiece of simple-line art." The series has won numerous prestigious awards, including the Netherlands' "Golden Pencil" Award, France's "Prix de Treize" Award, Germany's "Bestlist Award," and finally, in 2004, the "The Hans Christian Andersen Medal" (International Andersen Illustration Award).
summary_zh: 本页为绘本的结尾页，包含主题总结、思考题、实践建议以及作者简介。左侧强调学会给予和接受爱的重要性，并通过四个问题引导读者回顾弗洛格与小鸭的故事；右侧介绍了作者马克斯·维尔修思的生平及成就。
